extracted.intended_audience: creative professionals, agencies, aspiring creatives and entrants considering the D&AD 2025 Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Information and requirements for submitting work to the D&AD 2025 Awards, including new categories, judging principles, deadlines, and New Blood briefs for aspiring creatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judged solely on merit
rubrics_metrics.description: As always, the D&AD Awards are judged solely on merit by over 300 judges globally, with no quotas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the central evaluative principle for the Awards: entries are evaluated based on their merit rather than quotas or other non-merit factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent and anonymous voting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Voting is conducted independently and anonymously to protect fairness and impartiality during judging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strict abstention rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Judges must follow abstention rules (presumably to avoid conflicts of interest); this is cited as part of measures that protect the integrity of the judging process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strong emphasis on eliminating bias
rubrics_metrics.description: A strong emphasis on eliminating bias ensure the integrity of the judging process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Alongside anonymous voting and abstention rules, the Awards highlight proactive steps to minimise bias in decision-making.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creator Content category
rubrics_metrics.description: This new category will award the strategic use of influencers’ and creators’ creativity to deliver brand success.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries to this category should demonstrate strategic use of creators/influencers and show how creator-led creativity delivered tangible brand outcomes; the category reflects a shift in marketing and storytelling practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Branding category split: New Brand Identity vs Brand Identity Refresh
rubrics_metrics.description: The branding category has been divided into two distinct categories: New Brand Identity and Brand Identity Refresh.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The split was introduced to address the significant volume of entries (over 900 in 2024) so each submission receives focused attention from the jury; implies submissions should fit clearly into either a wholly new identity or an identity refresh.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor disciplines for 2025
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsor Disciplines for 2025 include advertising, branding, craft, design, engagement and experience, entertainment, health, and impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These disciplines define the broad subject areas/categories in which work can be entered and judged for the 2025 Awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Jury composition and leadership
rubrics_metrics.description: The 2025 Jury Presidents include a global mix of leading creative experts from leading international brands and agencies, including TikTok, Saatchi & Saatchi, The New York Times Magazine, VML, Framestore, Common People Films, Ogilvy Health, Publicis Groupe Germany, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights the calibre and global diversity of judges and jury presidents, suggesting entries will be evaluated by senior industry practitioners with varied expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Blood Awards purpose and briefs
rubrics_metrics.description: D&AD recently announced the briefs for its 2025 New Blood Awards, which champion, educate, and nurture aspiring creatives from around the world as they enter the workforce, allowing them to develop their skills and bolster their portfolios by working on client briefs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This programme is targeted at emerging creatives; briefs span UX/UI, animation, advertising, typography, PR and are set by brands (e.g., Depop, On, Giffgaff, Xbox, Yahoo!, Google Cloud, Suntory Global Spirits, Hellmann’s, HSBC). Entrants will be judged by leading industry figures and have opportunities to win a Pencil, join the New Blood Academy, and be featured in the D&AD Annual.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards dates and entry fee deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Key D&AD Awards 2025 dates: Super Early Bird 30% Off Entry Fee Deadline: December 04, 2024; Early Bird 20% Off Entry Fee Deadline: February 05, 2025; Final Entry Deadline: March 12, 2025; Judging: May 18 to 21, 2025 (County Hall, London); D&AD Festival & Awards Ceremony: May 21 to 22, 2025 (Southbank Centre, London).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are mandatory procedural timelines for submission and participation; fee discount tiers (super early/early bird) are tied to deadlines. Link to dandad.org/awards for entry and full details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Benefits of winning a D&AD Pencil
rubrics_metrics.description: Winning a D&AD Pencil elevates both individual careers and company profiles, contributing to D&AD rankings – the definitive league table of creative success. Winners also gain exposure to millions of viewers and readers through D&AD’s online and social channels and have opportunities to showcase their work in international exhibitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the professional and promotional value of awards as motivation and outcome metric for entrants.
